name: quoxlens
tagline: Judges what you show it, and can prove why.
description: Applies a reusable, versioned Lens (a declared evaluative stance) to an artifact and returns a typed, evidence-gated verdict: a finding needs a cited basis or it is dropped, never invented. Every live application is recorded as an AEE lens.applied envelope plus a VOLT evidence bundle, so a verdict is replayable, not just a chat response. Findings carry stable fingerprints and move through a real lifecycle (new, confirmed, accepted-risk, remediated, regressed) so a repeat sweep reports only what changed. An eval harness scores each Lens against a no-Lens baseline before it may claim to be proven; an unevaluated or losing Lens is stamped unproven everywhere it appears, including its own verdict. Panel judging (several Lenses independently assessing one artifact, with disagreement reported rather than averaged away) and gate mode (an AOCL policy naming a Lens as fail-closed admission control) are both engine-complete but not yet reachable from any route or wired to a real boundary. See docs/QUOXLENS_GATING.md.
